Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver a release-convergence candidate that restores recognizable automatic combat audio, improves authored cemetery exposure and spatial integrity, hardens complete-run and Retry behavior, and replaces text-stacked upgrade choices with truthful, input-complete visual hierarchy.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release-convergence candidate still has two blocking player-visible defects: automatic combat authorizes attacks but emits silent Effects output with no source events, while the authored cemetery view is underexposed and its central landmark dominates traversal framing. The complete-run release contract also lacks a host-verified deterministic lifecycle, and the required choice presentation capability needs an explicit implementation task.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or surgically alter the preserved authored cemetery package or retained weapon/component audio.
Keep implementation within three bounded families: combat audio causality, authored arena spatial integrity, and release shell/lifecycle readiness including upgrade-choice presentation.
Leave host runtime recapture, formal Tester verdicts, issue closure, and phase-gate decisions to validation ownership.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior transform tuning: repair the product-owned audio adapter and envelope/routing, reframe exposure and traversal around the intact authored map with explicit spatial checks, and unify lifecycle reset with release-shell and upgrade-choice state hardening.

code: Run focused static checks and project parse/import validation for edited scripts and scenes; verify no new parser errors, missing resources, or invalid node paths.
Exercise SEMI and quick AUTO through the authoritative input path and assert cadence, release, reset, and source-event state transitions in source-level or unit-style checks where available.

Verify lifecycle reset clears entities, timers, pools, HUD/result, and input locks; verify tester-only actions are release-build guarded and upgrade focus states are wired for keyboard, mouse, and gamepad.
runtime: Host recaptures Godot boot and the complete-run release matrix, including ordinary successful route, wave/upgrade/boss/result/Retry transitions, and fresh-run readiness.
Host runs the runtime audio causality probe with one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap, captures mixed Effects WAV plus source-event timeline, and reruns the same framing/state after repair.

Host runs sparse world/map probes at spawn, critical route, cardinal/landmark, and movement replay states, checking exposure, larger traversable scale, external depth, central landmark visibility, collision, boundary/perimeter, and no disappearance/occlusion drift; then reruns preserved native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks.
visual: Tester compares repaired cemetery screenshots against the prior failed exposure/composition cells using the same shipped camera/framing, confirming readable nocturnal contrast and reduced central-landmark occlusion.

Tester inspects SEMI/AUTO action-window frames for visible muzzle and impact causality without generic VFX replay, and confirms upgrade, result, and Retry presentation remains coherent across lifecycle states.

done_when: Exactly one bounded, recognizable firearm transient is emitted for one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap in actual mixed output, with product adapter/native component, miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, and character-hit stems isolated in diagnostics.

The retained component gun audio remains the sole player-report owner; generic shot VFX does not replay the complete player recording; sustained AUTO starts only after cadence-valid continuation and stops on release and lifecycle reset.
Fresh runtime audio capture shows non-silent Effects output and a source-event timeline causally aligned to both test inputs, with no long ringing material-impact cue masking the firearm report.
No unrelated weapon hierarchy, retained component asset, or source audio is changed.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned combat audio integration at the adapter, material-impact envelope, and routing layer. Inspect the weapon controller, attack runtime, audio director, and bound audio scene/resource; preserve the retained component FireAudio/AutoFireAudio path and hierarchy, and ensure SEMI and quick AUTO produce one short recognizable firearm transient in mixed output. Keep impact VFX and character-hit feedback, but isolate or disable player world-surface impact audio if its cue is long, generic, or masks the report. Add only focused instrumentation needed for source-event and mixed-output retest; do not substitute telemetry for audible behavior.
tasks.title: Restore automatic firearm audio causality and bounded report mix

done_when: The shipped cemetery view is visibly brighter and readable across spawn, critical route, and cardinal/landmark views without flattening the nocturnal art direction.

The authored map remains intact as the sole authoritative visual environment; expand to a larger traversable scale only through datum, spawn, objective, boundary, or camera framing changes, with coherent external world or external depth beyond the playable perimeter.

The central building or landmark remains authored and prominent but no longer causes camera occlusion, disappearance, or traversal ambiguity; ordinary movement and a movement replay keep it visible when expected.

Collision aligns with the authored streets and landmark footprint; no pass-through, void, proxy-floor, or boundary/perimeter escape is observed, and central landmark visibility is stable under ordinary movement.

The arena/spatial capability is explicit: larger traversable scale, external depth, central building/landmark, collision, disappearance/occlusion, boundary/perimeter, and ordinary movement/movement replay are all validated against the same authored package.
tasks.instructions: Rework world presentation and spatial bindings around the intact authored cemetery package rather than replacing it. Diagnose underexposure and central-landmark dominance, then adjust environment lighting/exposure, camera framing, outer datum, spawn/objective anchors, collision/navigation, and gameplay boundary as needed. Preserve native streets, buildings, props, materials, and landmark geometry. Ensure a larger traversable scale with coherent external world depth, a central building/landmark that does not disappear or occlude ordinary movement, aligned collision, and a stable boundary/perimeter under movement replay. Remove or minimize unrelated proxy/support clutter if it competes with the authored composition.
tasks.title: Restore authored cemetery exposure and spatial integrity

done_when: A normal successful run can advance through wave progression, level-up/upgrade choice, boss or terminal objective, result, and Retry into a fresh authoritative run without stale entities, audio, HUD, or score state.

Lifecycle reset is idempotent and clears active combat timers, AUTO-fire cadence, enemy/projectile pools, experience/upgrade state, vitality/result screens, and input locks before the new run accepts movement and combat.
Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy led by weapon or upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, and restrained consequence copy.

Each choice shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; unchanged, exhaustive, NEW, and LOCKED placeholder rows are omitted, and the CURRENT column never uses NEW or LOCKED.
Upgrade cards expose distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, selected, and unavailable states without changing card dimensions or hiding authoritative tradeoffs.

The candidate exposes deterministic, release-safe state transitions sufficient for host to recapture complete-run evidence; tester-only setup actions, if present, are unbound from release exports and cannot qualify an ordinary successful route.
No regression is introduced to preserved HUD hierarchy, vitality bindings, weapon strategies, or clean Godot boot/log behavior.
tasks.instructions: Harden the authoritative run lifecycle, Retry/reset integration, and release shell so a complete ordinary route is recapture-ready. Trace scene/state transitions from run start through wave, upgrade draft, boss, result, and back to a fresh run, then ensure reset clears gameplay, audio cadence, pools, HUD/result state, and input locks in one idempotent path. Implement the required survivor choice visual hierarchy in the same shell boundary: replace text-stacked choices with authored silhouettes or icons, compact truthful current-to-new deltas capped at three, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus behavior. Keep tester-only preparation isolated behind a release-build guard and do not use it as ordinary-route evidence. Preserve existing HUD, vitality, weapon, and authored-world bindings while making lifecycle and choice presentation deterministic for host retest.
tasks.title: Make complete-run lifecycle and choice visual hierarchy release-ready
